<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the molecular formula C9H9O4 (C=9, H=9, N=0, X=0), the calculation gives DBE = (2*9 + 2 - 9)/2 = 11/2 = 5.5. Since the required answer format is an integer, we round down to the nearest whole number, yielding 5.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
